narrative.northStar: Apothecary calm, app-like on mobile, complete on desktop.
narrative.overview: Search, category shortcuts and the campaign hero lead the Al Mina storefront. Phone screens keep buying controls close. Desktop uses a pill search field, a mint department strip and five-column home shelves. Plus Jakarta Sans and IBM Plex Sans Arabic support English and Arabic. Deep apothecary green identifies buying actions, mint builds supporting surfaces, and coral marks the brand, cart counts and verified offers.
keyCharacteristics: Search-led navigation with delivery context and useful discovery.
Calm off-white canvas, white surfaces, mint supporting fills and deep-green buying actions.
Quiet product cards with contained factual photography, a generous photo well and readable prices.
Image-first phone PDP with contextual overlay controls and persistent buying.
Equivalent English/Arabic tasks and desktop/mobile continuity.

rules.name: The action-foreground rule.
rules.body: Use white on action green for accessible labels and pending states. Contrast is 8.05:1 at rest and 10.65:1 on hover. Use dark ink on coral badges at 5.91:1. Keyboard focus uses a visible outline or a brand border and soft ring.

rules.name: The state-meaning rule.
rules.body: Selected options use their mint selected surface plus current/pressed semantics; the strongest option uses green text and weight rather than a filled pill. Bottom navigation retains its active-navigation green with aria-current. Added/success uses positive treatment and a real count/status; saved uses its heart/pressed state; error uses explicit invalid/alert treatment. Offer text/surface is separate from error and cannot imply an actual promotion without verified data. Stock/unavailable retain literal status text. Inactive controls use disabled roles; their 4.98:1 text pairing is an inactive-control exemption, not a normal-text pass.

rules.name: The feedback-motion rule.
rules.body: Background, border and text changes and pointer press feedback use 120ms. Pointer-initiated menu, review and campaign disclosures use the 180ms entry role. Confirmed status indicators can fade in on the same timing. Both use `cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.2,1)`. Keyboard carousel controls render the next slide immediately. Reduced motion preserves immediate final states. Pack comparison and navigation stay steady. Stroked UI icons use Heroicons at 22px/1.5, with separate filled dirham artwork.

dos: Do preserve the accepted direction, actual business content, English/Arabic tasks and server authority.
Do use the single scoped runtime token/state owners and verify emitted/computed CSS, portal ancestry and live resizing.
Do test names, missing content, unavailable/pending/failed states, focus, enlarged text and purchase clearance.
Do preserve shared/admin consumers until replacement is verified and distinguish local direction acceptance from release acceptance.
donts: Don't restore the superseded blue #1855ba action palette or the categories-first home order.
Don't restore retired lavender/teal candidate values, split desktop lead or standalone phone PDP toolbar as default guidance.
Don't generate a competing palette/font/token system from skills, metadata snippets, references or the archive.
Don't copy unsupported ratings, delivery promises, medical claims, prices, discounts, services or payment availability.
Don't deploy, access production data or change commerce behavior as part of this design phase.
